nap: Aissera, Nanniné, me ne sagliette,
eng: I climbed up high yesterday evening, oh, Nannina,

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: tu saje addò? (Tu saje addò?)
eng: Do you know where? (Do you know where?)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Addò 'sto core 'ngrato cchiù dispietto, farme nun pò! (Farme nun pò!)
eng: Where this ungrateful heart No longer pains me! (No longer pains me!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Addó lo fuoco coce, ma se fuje, te lassa sta! (Te lassa sta!)
eng: Where fire burns, but if you run away, just with a look! (Just with a look!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: E nun te corre appriesso, nun te struje, sulo a guardà! (Sulo a guardà!)
eng: It doesn't follow after or torment you, just with a look! (Just with a look!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Jamme, jamme 'ncoppa, jamme jà, funiculì, funiculà, funiculì, funiculà, 'ncoppa, jamme jà, funiculì, funiculà!
eng: Let's go, let's go! To the top we'll go! Funicular up, funicular down, funicular up, funicular down! To the top we'll go, funicular up, funicular down!

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

notes: repeated

nap: Né, jamme da la terra a la montagna, nu passo nc'è! (Nu passo nc'è!)
eng: Let's go from here below up to the mountain, A step away! (A step away!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Se vède Francia, Proceta e la Spagna...Io veco a tte! (Io veco a tte!)
eng: You can see France, Procida, and Spain, and I see you! (And I see you!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Tirato co la fune, ditto 'nfatto, 'ncielo se va! ('ncielo se va!)
eng: You rise, pulled by a cable, quick as a wink, into the sky! (Into the sky!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Se va comm' 'a lo viento a l'intrasatto, guè, saglie, sà! (Guè, saglie, sà!)
eng: We'll rise up like a whirlwind all of a sudden, knows how to do! (Knows how to do!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Se n'è sagliuta, oje né, se n'è sagliuta, la capa già! (La capa già!)
eng: The car has climbed up high, see, climbed up high now, right to the top! (Right to the top!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

notes: suspect a difference in historicity between original and English text

nap: È gghiuta, po' è turnata, po' è venuta, sta sempe ccà! (Sta sempe ccà!)
eng: It went, and turned around, and came back down, it's always there! (It's always there!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: La capa vota, vota, attuorno, attuorno, attuorno a tte! (Attuorno a tte!)
eng: The top is turning round, and round, and round, around yourself! (Around yourself!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: 'Sto core canta sempe nu taluorno: Sposamme, oje né! (Sposamme, oje né!)
eng: My heart is singing the same refrain: We should be wed! (We should be wed!)

source.reference: Mike Bivona, Traveling Around the World with Mike and Barbara Bivona, iUniverse. ISBN 978-1-4917-1041-8, p. 119

nap: Quanno sponta la luna a Marechiare, pure li pisce nce fann' a l'ammore, se revotano l'onne de lu mare, pe la priezza cagneno culore
eng: When the moon looks down and shines on Marechiaro, even the fish make love! The waves of the sea kick up and change color just from joy
notes: ENG translation by blog author, who is a linguistics professor with Italian fluency. Neapolitan competency is unverified.

nap: A Marechiare nce sta na fenesta, e' la passione mia nce tuzzulea,
eng: But at Marechechiare there's a window that I softly tap on with my heart
notes: ENG translation by blog author, who is a linguistics professor with Italian fluency. Neapolitan competency is unverified.

nap: nu carofano adora int'a na testa, passa l'acqua pe sotto e murmuléa, A Marechiare nce sta na fenesta
eng: There's a fragrant carnation in a vase, the sea below softly murmurs, at Marechiare there's a window
notes: ENG translation by blog author, who is a linguistics professor with Italian fluency. Neapolitan competency is unverified.

nap: Dicitencello a 'sta cumpagna vosta ch'aggio perduto 'o suonno e 'a fantasia...ch''a penzo sempe, ch'è tutt''a vita mia...I' nce 'o vvulesse dicere, ma nun ce 'o ssaccio dí...
eng: Tell her, tell that friend of yours that I've been losing sleep and my mind's a blank. Say I'm always thinking about her, that she's my whole life...I'd like to tell her, but I don't know how to say
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: 'A voglio bene, 'A volgio bene assaje!
eng: That I love her, I love her very much!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Dicitencello vuje ca nun mm''a scordo maje.
eng: You tell her the truth that I'll never forget her.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E' na passione, cchiù forte 'e na catena, ca mme turmenta ll'anema...e nun mme fa campá!...
eng: It's a passion stronger than chains, it torments my soul and I can't go on.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Na lácrema lucente v'è caduta...dicíteme nu poco: a che penzate?!
eng: A glistening tear slid down your cheek, tell me, what goes through your mind?
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Cu st'uocchie doce, vuje sola mme guardate...
eng: Such sweet eyes, are yours and yours alone
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Levámmoce 'sta maschera, dicimmo 'a veritá...
eng: Let's get rid of this mask, and tell the truth...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Te voglio bene, te voglio bene assaje. Si' tu chesta catena ca nun se spezza maje
eng: I love you, I really love you. You are these chains that will never break!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Suonno gentile suspri mio carnale. Te cerco comm'a ll'aria: Te voglio pe' campá!
eng: A soft sound, my senses sigh. I need you like the air I breathe: I need you to go on!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Partono 'e bastimente p' 'e terre assaje luntane, cantano a buordo e so' napulitane!
eng: The boats are leaving for far away lands, on board they sing, "I'm a Neapolitan!"
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Cantano pe' tramente 'o golfo già scompare, e 'a luna, 'a miez' 'o mare, 'nu poco 'e Napule lle fa vede'.
eng: They sing while in the sunset, the bay disappears, and as the half-moon of the sea still reveals a little of Naples.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Santa Lucia, luntano 'a te quanta malincunia!
eng: Saint Lucia, how sad it is to be so far from you!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Se gira 'o munno sano, se va a cerca' furtuna, ma quanno sponta 'a luna luntano a Napule, nun se po' sta!
eng: One circles the world, one seeks one's fortune, but when the moon rises far from Naples, one cannot stay away!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Santa Lucia tu tiene solo 'nu poco 'e mare, ma cchiù luntana staie, cchiù bella pare!
eng: Saint Lucia, yours is only a little sea, but the longer I stay away, the more beautiful you are!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: È 'o canto d' 'e Ssirene ca tesse ancora 'e rezze, core, nun vo' ricchezze: si è nato a Napule ce vo' muri'!
eng: It is like the song of the sirens that are still casting their net, my heart doesn't want riches: If it was born in Naples, it wants to die there!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Arápete fenesta! Famme affacciá a Maria, ca stóngo 'mmiez'â via... speruto d''a vedé... Nun trovo n'ora 'e pace: 'a notte 'a faccio juorno, sempe pe' stá ccá attuorno, speranno 'e ce parlá!
eng: Open the window! And let Maria look out, I'm standing here in the middle of the road... Desperate to see her... I can't get an hour's peace: The night's the same as the day to me, always hanging around here, hoping to talk to her!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Oje Marí', oje Marí', quanta suonno ca perdo pe' te! Famme addurmí, abbracciato nu poco cu te!
eng: Oh Marie, oh Marie, how much sleep I lose for you! Just let me fall asleep, hugging you for a while!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Oje Marí', oje Marí', Pare che giá s'arape na sénga 'e fenestella...
eng: Oh Marie, oh Marie, now it looks like one of the window shutters is opening...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Maria cu 'a manella, nu segno a me mme fa! Sòna chitarra mia!
eng: Marie puts out her hand, and waves to me! I play my guitar!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Fenesta che lucive e mo nun luce... sign'è ca nénna mia stace malata... S'affaccia la surella e mme lu dice: Nennélla toja è morta e s'è atterrata...
eng: The once-lit window, now dark... means that my sweetheart is ill... Her sister looks out and tells me: Your sweetheart is dead and buried...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Chiagneva sempe ca durmeva sola, mo dorme co' li muorte accompagnata...
eng: She once complained that she slept alone, now she sleeps in the company of the dead...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Va' dint''a cchiesa, e scuopre lu tavuto: vide nennélla toja comm'è tornata... Da chella vocca ca n'ascéano sciure, mo n'esceno li vierme...Oh! che piatate!
eng: Go to the church, and look into her coffin: See how your sweetheart is now... From the mouth that once came words of love, but now only worms... Oh! What sadness!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Zi' parrocchiano mio, ábbece cura: na lampa sempe tienece allummata...
eng: Priest: take care of my little one: always keep a lamp lit by her...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Comm'è bella 'a muntagna stanotte...bella accussí, nun ll'aggio vista maje!
eng: How beautiful the mountain is tonight...I have never seen it more lovely!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: N'ánema pare, rassignata e stanca, sott''a cuperta 'e chesta luna janca...
eng: It looks like a resigned and tired soul under the cover of this white moon.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Tu ca nun chiagne e chiágnere mme faje, tu, stanotte, addó' staje?
eng: You who do not cry and make me cry, where are you tonight?
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Comm'è calma 'a muntagna stanotte...cchiù calma 'e mo, nun ll'aggio vista maje!
eng: How calm the moon is tonight...calmer than I have ever seen it before!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E tutto dorme, tutto dorme o more, e i' sulo veglio, pecché veglia Ammore...
eng: And everything sleeps, everything sleeps or dies. Only I am awake, because Love is awake!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Si 'sta voce te sceta 'int'a nuttata, mntre t'astringe 'o sposo tuio vicino, statte scetata, si vuo sta scetata, ma fa vede ca duorme a suonno chino.
eng: If this voice wakes you in the night, while the man at your side is holding you, stay awake if you want to stay awake, but pretend that you're fast asleep.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Nun gghi vicino'e llastre pe' ffa' spia, pecche nun puo sbaglia: 'sta voce e'e mia...
eng: Don't go to the window to see who's there, becuase you can't mistake it: that voice is mine...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E'a stessa voce 'e quanno tutt'e dduie scurnuse, nce parlavamo c'o "vvuie".
eng: The same voice as when we both were strangers, and both so formal with each other.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Si 'sta voce, che chiagn'int' `a nuttata te sceta'o sposo, nun ave paura, vide ch'e senza nomme'a sserenata...Dille ca dorme e ca se rassicura...
eng: If this voice crying into the night wakes your man, don't be afraid, because there are no names in my seranade... Tell him to sleep, that everything's all right.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Dille accussi: "Chi canta 'inta 'sta via o sarra pazzo o more'e ggelusia. Starra chiagneno quacce `nfamita, canta isso sulo. Ma che canta a ffa?"
eng: Tell him: "Whoever is singing down in the street is either crazy or dying of jealousy. He's probably crying over some betrayal, he sings alone. But what's he singing for?"
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Quanno vien'a 'appuntamento guarde 'o mare, guard''e ffronne, si te parlo nun rispunne, staje distratta comm'a che.
eng: Whenever we meet you look at the sea, at the leaves, if I speak to you, you don't respond, you are very distracted.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Io te tengo dint''o core, songo sempe 'nnammurato ma tu, invece, pienze a n'ato e te staje scurdanno 'e me...
eng: I have you in my heart, I am still in love with you, but you, instead, think about someone else and you are forgetting about me...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Quanno se dice: "Si'" tienelo a mente...Nun s'ha da fa muri' nu core amante...
eng: When one has said "Yes," you must remember...One should not cause another heart to die...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Tu mme diciste: "Si" na sera 'e maggio...e mo tiene 'o curaggio 'e mme lassa'!
eng: You said to me "Yes," one evening in May...And now you have the courage to leave me!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: St'uocchie tuoje nun so' sincere comm'a quanno mme 'ncuntraste, comm'a quanno mme diciste: "Voglio bene sulo a te..."
eng: I don't know if those eyes of yours are sincere as they were when you met me, when you told me: "I only love you..."
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E tremmanno mme giuraste, cu na mano 'ncopp''o core: "Nun se scorda 'o primmo ammore!..." Mo te staje scurdanno 'e me...
eng: And trembling you swore to me, with your hand on your heart: "One doesn't forget one's first love!..." But now you are forgetting me...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Staje luntana da stu core, a te volo cu 'o penziero
eng: You are far from my heart, and I fly to you in my thoughts
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: niente voglio e niente spero ca tenerte sempe a fianco a me!
eng: I want nothing, and I hope for nothing
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Si' sicura 'e chist'ammore comm'i' só' sicuro 'e te...
eng: Be sure of this love as I am sure of you...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Oje vita, oje vita mia...oje core 'e chistu core...si' stata 'o primmo ammore...e 'o primmo e ll'ùrdemo sarraje pe' me!
eng: Oh life, oh my life...Oh heart, oh this heart, you were my first love, my first, and you will be my last!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Scrive sempe e sta' cuntenta: io nun penzo che a te sola...
eng: I always write saying you should be happy: I only think of you...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Nu penziero mme cunzola, ca tu pienze sulamente a me...
eng: And one thought consoles me, that you only think of me...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: 'A cchiù bella 'e tutt''e bbelle nun è maje cchiù bella 'e te!
eng: The most beautiful of beautiful women is not nearly as beautiful as you!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Cchiù luntana mme staje, cchiù vicina te sento...
eng: The further from me you are, the closer to you I feel...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Chisà a chistu mumento tu a che pienze...che faje!...
eng: Who knows in this moment what you're thinking...what you're doing!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Tu m'e' miso 'int''e vvene, nu veleno ch'è doce...
eng: You've poured into my veins a sweet poison...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Comme pesa 'sta croce ca trascino pe' te!...
eng: How heavy is this cross that I bear for you!...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Te voglio...te penzo...te chiammo...te veco...te sento...te sonno...
eng: I want you, I think of you, I call you, I see you, I hear you, I dream of you...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E' n'anno, 'nce pienze ch'è n'anno ca stu'occhie nun ponno cchiù pace truvà!...
eng: Just think, it's been a year, a whole year that these eyes have known no peace!
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: E cammino, cammino...ma nun saccio addo' vaco...
eng: And I walk and walk, but I don't know where I'm going...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: I' sto' sempe 'mbriaco e nun bevo maje vino...
eng: I'm always drunk though I never drink wine...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Aggio fatto nu vuto a' Madonna d''a neve: si mme passa 'sta freve, oro e perle lle do'...
eng: I've made a vow to Our Lady of the Snow: that if this fever passes, I'll offer her gold and pearls...
notes: ENG translation by blog author team. Includes linguists.

nap: Scinne cu 'mme' 'nfunn 'o mare a truva' chello ca nun tenimmo cca'.
ita_intermediate: Scendi con me in fondo al mare a trovare quello che non abbiamo qui
eng: Come down with me down into the sea to find what we have here
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: Viene cu 'mme e accumincia a capi' comm'è inutile a sta' a suffri'.
ita_intermediate: Vieni con me e comincia a capire come è inutile stare a soffrire
eng: Come with me and begin to understand how useless is to suffer
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: Guarda stu mare ca ce 'nfonne e paure sta cercanno e ce 'mbara'.
ita_intermediate: Guarda questo mare che ci infonde le paure sta cercando di insegnarci.
eng: Look at this sea that gives us fears it is trying to teach us.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: Ah... comme se fa' adda' turmiento all'anema ca vo' vula' si tu nun scinn 'nfunno nun 'o puo' sape'.
ita_intermediate: Ah, come si fa a tormentare l'anima che vuole volare se tu non scendi in fondo non lo puoi sapere
eng: Ah, how can you plague a soul that wants to fly if you don't go down You cannot know
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: No, comme se fa' a te piglia' sultanto o' male ca ce sta' e po' lassa' stu core sulo in miezz a via
ita_intermediate: No, come si fa a prendere soltanto il male che c'è e poi lasciare questo cuore solo in mezzo alla strada
eng: No, how can you take only the pain there is and then leave this heart alone in the street
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: GSaglie cu 'mme' e accumincia a canta' 'nzieme e 'note ca l'aria da'.
ita_intermediate: Sali con me e comincia a cantare insieme alle note che l'aria dà
eng: Come up with me and begin to sing with the notes that the air gives
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: Senza guarda' tu cuntinui a vula' mentre o viento ce porta a 'lla'.
ita_intermediate: Senza guardare tu continua a volare mentre il vento ci porta là
eng: Without looking Keep flying while the wind takes us there.
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).

nap: Addo' ce stanno e parole cchiu' belle e te piglie pe' te 'mbara'.
ita_intermediate: Dove ci sono le parole più belle che prendi per imparare
eng: Where are the most beautiful words you take to learn
notes: ENG translation by blog author team, for a passion-blog on Italian heritage. However, there is no explicit qualification listed for the translator(s).
